rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an informational or advertising leaflet, including one left on a car.

example.english: I found a leaflet on my car introducing a new restaurant.
example.traditional: 我喺車頭見到一張介紹新餐廳嘅傳單。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ce1 tau4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zoeng1 gaai3 siu6 san1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cyun4 daan1
